query_analysis.original_query: Can you help me develop a comprehensive uncertainty quantification framework for our advanced ceramic membrane separation process used in high-temperature gas processing?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed uncertainty quantification framework for our advanced ceramic membrane separation process used in high-temperature gas processing, including identification of uncertainty sources, modeling and simulation, statistical analysis, and recommendations to mitigate uncertainties impacting process performance.

selected_agents.role: Lead development of the uncertainty quantification framework
Provide process expertise and identify sources of uncertainty
Assess impact of high-temperature conditions on uncertainties

communication_strategy.information_flow: Process details and uncertainty sources are provided to the Mathematical Solver for modeling
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative framework development with continuous integration of domain expertise

clarification_questions: What are the specific uncertainty sources in your membrane separation process?
Do you have existing data on process performance under various operating conditions?
Are there particular performance metrics or regulatory requirements to consider in the analysis?
